crossRefs.note: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out…

people.name: Meshelemiah
people.line: A Levite gatekeeper in the time of David.

people.name: Zechariah
people.line: Levite gatekeeper and musician during David's reign

translations.web: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translations.bsb: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
translations.kjv: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.asv: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tent of meeting.
